understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by placing all selectable pieces onto the goal tiles marked '+' so that every goal tile is occupied simultaneously, progressing through all levels until the engine reports WIN for the final run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions (UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT) attempt to shift the currently selected selectable piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in that direction; the piece may fail to move if blocked by walls or other impassable boundaries. Some adjacent objects are pushable blocks that can be pushed if directly next to the selected piece in the movement direction and space allows. Levels can contain multiple selectable pieces, and control is switched by CLICKing a selectable's exact pixel/grid position as listed in the state; wall-like tiles can have differing blocking behavior, so attempted moves are sometimes needed to confirm whether motion is possible.
